components.responsibility: Preserve this stable boundary while refining its ownership and contracts.

components.label: Admission controller
components.responsibility: Authenticate tenant and atomically reserve quota plus physical capacity.

components.label: Quota ledger
components.responsibility: Own tenant limits, active reservations and cluster free capacity.

components.label: Fair queue
components.responsibility: Queue by declared weighted-share policy with bounded per-tenant pending requests.

components.label: Node allocator
components.responsibility: Assign one resource vector and lease epoch; reject stale allocation commands.

components.label: Runtime isolation
components.responsibility: Install cgroup CPU/memory and supported device/network controls before starting user code.

components.label: Usage journal
components.responsibility: Record monotonic start/end intervals with allocation/fence and sequence; deduplicate retries.

components.label: Idle pool planner
components.responsibility: Keep warm capacity under an explicit idle budget; stop only after fenced idle timeout and drain.

components.label: Reservation reconciler
components.responsibility: Compare node leases and ledger reservations; fence the old allocation before releasing reusable capacity.

components.label: Caller
components.responsibility: Submit the declared operation with stable identity and observe explicit completion.

components.label: Hierarchical expiring token leases
components.responsibility: Preserve this stable boundary while refining its ownership and contracts.

components.label: Global quota issuer
components.responsibility: Partition quota into nonoverlapping expiring resource leases.

components.label: Global lease ledger
components.responsibility: Own token amounts, holder, epoch and revocation state.

components.label: Regional quota cache
components.responsibility: Spend only within a region-held resource lease and persist each allocation deduction.

components.label: Local scheduler
components.responsibility: Serialize per-lease vector deductions and bounded weighted local queues.

components.label: Fenced runtime
components.responsibility: Stop or renew allocations before lease safety deadline and enforce epochs at runtime.

components.label: Usage aggregation
components.responsibility: Deduplicate interval sequences by allocation/epoch before rolling up tenant totals.

components.label: Lease rebalancer
components.responsibility: Reissue only after revoke/ack or safe expiry/fence, never by assuming a disconnected holder stopped.

components.label: Warm-pool governor
components.responsibility: Reserve a bounded warm subset under the same regional grant and reclaim on idle policy.

requirements.text: Admit only resources covered by tenant quota and cluster capacity.
Enforce runtime isolation independently of admission and prevent noisy-neighbor budget theft.
Reclaim failed allocations and account usage once per fenced measurement interval.

problem.scope: Allocate CPU/GPU capacity with admission, runtime isolation and measured accounting as separate authorities. Compare central reservations with bounded hierarchical token leases. Millisecond units are an accounting representation, not a promise of measurement accuracy.

provenance.note: Authored interview preparation. Technical references support mechanisms, not the claim that a company asked this question.

acceptanceCases.then: At most one reservation fits the remaining vector.
acceptanceCases.when: Serialize reservations in the central ledger.

acceptanceCases.given: A node reports the same allocation interval twice.
acceptanceCases.then: Charge the interval and release capacity once in the bounded model.
acceptanceCases.when: Reconcile and release the reservation twice.

evidence.testName: resource vectors and interval identities prevent local overspend and double charge

acceptanceCases.given: One GPU remains and usage reports carry allocation/epoch/sequence.
acceptanceCases.then: Reject overspend and count one interval per identity in this sequential model.
acceptanceCases.when: Reserve twice and repeat one usage identity.

guarantees: Quota limit is not a fairness guarantee.
One reservation cannot be placed twice.
GPU scheduling isolation needs its own supported mechanism; quota alone is insufficient.
Wall-clock changes cannot create negative or duplicate elapsed usage.
A queued new request prevents unsafe idle teardown.
Lease expiry without fencing cannot safely free capacity.
